CRL.M.A. 3189/2025 (Exemption) Exemption allowed subject to just exceptions.
The application stands disposed of.

1. The instant bail application under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (earlier under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973) has been filed on behalf of the petitioner/applicant seeking grant of regular bail in FIR No. 624/2023 registered at Police Station Nabi Karim for the offence punishable under Sections 304B/498A/302/201/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2. Heard.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 05/02/2025 at 22:01:15 3.
Issue notice.
Learned APP for the State appearing on advance notice accepted notice and vehemently opposed the instant application.
He prayed for four weeks' time to file the status report.
Let the same be filed within four weeks as prayed.
4. The nominal roll of the applicant be called from the Jail Authority concerned within a week.
5. List on 23rd April, 2025.
